currentOverlay.negative: Mixed invalid date/instant data, end-before-start, invalid progress/dependency, or a deferred Gantt renderer cannot be normalized, rendered, or claimed supported, and runtime failure does not rewrite preserved legal author bytes.

currentOverlay.positive: Definition-save handling preserves statically legal authored members through builder/advanced routing; supported alternatives may consume existing complete current data without D8 inventing quantiles.
currentOverlay.negative: Bad runtime quartile order fails the runtime View gate; D8 never calculates quantiles or enables deferred boxplot merely because a chart library can, and the saved legal definition is not rewritten.

currentOverlay.positive: Builder saves a statically valid definition independently of result pages; renderer/export waits for a complete current ResultHandle and exposes incomplete_result distinctly.
currentOverlay.negative: First page, stale page cache, timeout, or other incomplete data cannot be treated as a complete chart or complete-zero result and cannot invalidate or mutate the saved definition.

currentOverlay.scenario: ACL reset offline provider and renderer crash
currentOverlay.positive: Definition bytes survive result ACL/reset/offline/provider/renderer states; runtime validation rechecks current result authorization/epoch and may use only an allowed same-complete-data fallback after renderer failure.
currentOverlay.negative: Old authorization/result/schema is never reused after reset; offline/provider/data/renderer failure cannot become empty data and cannot mutate or invalidate the ViewSpec, while a revoked definition owner still blocks a new save through the definition-save gate.

currentOverlay.scenario: cross-surface CJK RTL print and fallback
currentOverlay.positive: Desktop/WebUI/Mobile/CLI/Server apply the same static definition-save semantics; claimed renderers then apply the same complete-result runtime semantics while preserving CJK/RTL logical order, same-data accessibility, and print/export meaning.
currentOverlay.negative: Surface UI cannot alter Query/ViewSpec semantics, reverse RTL data, sample Mobile data, or let CLI/Server claim pixels; runtime capability failure cannot rewrite the saved definition.

currentOverlay.positive: Each Dashboard block has its own static definition-save gate and independent runtime authorization/complete-result/render gate; one denied/unavailable block has an isolated error while other authorized blocks remain usable.
currentOverlay.negative: One block runtime failure cannot leak data, poison unrelated blocks, trigger hidden cross-block reads, create a Dashboard authorization boundary, or invalidate another block's saved definition.
